notes: One entry per P2ID address scheme, keyed by its salt name (pvium.vault.v1; a later stack gets its own, e.g. pvium.vault.v2). A scheme fixes every address: p2id = CREATE2(factory, identityHash, vaultInitCodeHash), with identityHash computed under identityDomain. Each Pvium environment is a separate stack with its own factory: `production` (mainnets) and `sandbox` (testnets); within an environment the factory has one address on every chain. The scheme domain is also the factory's namespace (nsHash = keccak256(domain)) and the deterministic-deployment salt. Entries are history: once a production factory is recorded the entry is frozen, and a vault change means adding a new entry and moving `current`; older schemes stay derivable forever. A sandbox factory never freezes anything: while production is null, `node scripts/embed-p2id.mjs --update` refreshes vaultInitCodeHash from the Hardhat artifact and the sandbox factory is re-predicted. `verifiers` lists, per environment, the approved verifier of each circuit version (keyed by circuitVersion); the newest is what new payments fund under (fundWith). Verifiers are added when the policy approves them and are never removed, so older deposits stay claimable with their own verifier. `solana` is the scheme's Solana stack: the program ids (one per program on every cluster), per environment the factory as recorded from its deployment (address, authority and the parameters its address commits to, reproducible from them; null until recorded) and the verifier program of each circuit version with the zk program behind it and its vk hash (keys differ per environment on Solana, so each environment has its own). `node scripts/embed-p2id.mjs --update` fills these from solana-anchor/deployments; a recorded production factory freezes the entry like the EVM one.
